warnings: No baseline visibility, ranking, mention, citation or target-performance data entered this QA pass. No candidate was selected or removed because of how the target currently performs.

Embedding-based similarity was NOT run: no fixed embedding model/version was available in this run. Duplicate detection used exact normalized-hash comparison plus lexical overlap plus manual semantic review. Recorded as a method limitation, not a clean pass.
For readability, the 'evidence' array is written only on rule results whose status is not 'pass'. An empty evidence array is implied on passing results.
Deterministic hashing was unavailable, so exact-duplicate detection compared normalized strings directly rather than SHA-256 digests. No two normalized strings collided.

rule_catalog.description: Schema and provenance completeness: every candidate has variant_role, text, language, locale, transformation, source_ids, evidence_grade, locale_review_status.
No target brand, product, domain, person, slogan, proprietary category or flattering claim in any candidate whose cell is not covered by a declared allowed_exception.
No campaign_terms (including target-originated policy framing such as 'mixed-use crawlers') outside the declared B5 aided exception.
No competitor_terms outside a declared competitor_aided aided-partition cell.
No wording traceable to an observed assistant answer or to target-owned page copy.
Unicode NFKC normalization, declared language matches text, length within bounds, one concept per prompt.
Exact normalized-string comparison plus lexical-overlap pair review; semantic pairs are reviewed by a human-equivalent judgement and never auto-deleted.
Prompt is entailed by the cited source evidence and does not assert a fact the sources do not support.
No recommendation forcing: an informational need is not converted into a purchase question to elicit brands.
Band, aided status, act, journey, expected answer kind, partition and lane eligibility are mutually consistent with prompt_architecture.json.
Non-default locale candidates carry locale_review_status and stay outside core until reviewed.
Grade-D candidates are confined to rotating or quarantined partitions unless explicitly promoted with evidence.
